description: OmniFocus overdue task query used a custom AppleScript iterating flattened tasks of each project instead of the vetted pattern in skills/omnifocus-tasks/SKILL.md (`every flattened task where due date < current date and completed is false`). This returned already-completed tasks. Additionally, Desktop Commander was declared unavailable for Plaud staging check when it is always available — ToolSearch was not run to confirm before reporting it as unavailable.
correction: Use `every flattened task where (due date is not missing value) and (due date < current date) and (completed is false)` at the document level, exactly as written in the skill. For any data source on the host Mac, run ToolSearch for Desktop Commander first — never declare it unavailable without checking.
systemic_fix: The correct AppleScript pattern is already in skills/omnifocus-tasks/SKILL.md and SYSTEM.md. The Desktop Commander availability rule is already in SYSTEM.md. Both rules were skipped under execution pressure. No new rules needed — enforce the existing ones.
